description:
Command-line Git information tool

Onefetch is a command-line Git information tool written in Rust that displays project information and code statistics for a local Git repository directly to your terminal.
The tool is completely offline - no network access is required.
What's Changed
Breaking Changes
- --no-bots is replaced by --ignore-author <REGEX>. To ignore bots like before, use --ignore-author '\[bot\]' in #1920
- --type is renamed to --language-types (-T still works) in #1917
- --exclude no longer hides files from Churn in #1927
New Features
- Save your options in a config file at ~/.config/onefetch/config.jsonc in #1917
- Co-authors from Co-authored-by trailers now count in Authors and Contributors in #1907
- Add Twig language support in #1928
Bug Fixes
- Ignored authors no longer affect the Created and Last change dates in #1922
Full Changelog: 3.1.0...3.2.0
